column1: # Every R package the figure scripts, the four fits and lib/ load, with the
# version a panel needs where one is pinned. setup/install_packages.R installs
# this list and setup/preflight.sh checks it. Maintained by hand: change it when
# a script starts or stops loading a package.
#                    ">= x": a floor. Below it the preflight FAILs and the
#                    installer moves the package to the current release, because
#                    the version decides numbers (ggpubr < 1.0.0 adjusts p across
#                    a different set of rows, and FIG4G and ED6E move).
#                    "== x": the version every panel in assembled/ was drawn
#                    under. A different one is a WARN; the installer leaves it
# install            the one-line R call that installs the package on its own.
#                    CRAN and Bioconductor packages need BiocManager at the
#                    release that pairs with your R (3.20 on R 4.4); GitHub
#                    packages need remotes. The call installs the current
# Not listed: base, grDevices, grid, stats, utils, methods, ... (versioned with
# R itself), and MotrpacHumanPreSuspension, which no script here names.
# Four rows are Bioconductor annotation packages rather than software: GO.db and
# AnnotationDbi (figure_3/ST3.R, for ST3g and ST3h), and org.Hs.eg.db and
# rstatix is loaded by no script: ggpubr >= 1.0.0 requires it.

column3: remotes::install_github("MoTrPAC/MotrpacHumanPreSuspensionData")  (private: set GITHUB_PAT, or remotes::install_local("<path to the checkout>"))
